description: Supply Chain & Energy Transition Intelligence — two structural economic endpoints bundled. (1) supply-chain: global supply chain pressure index with waterway chokepoint scoring across 6 shipping lanes (Suez, Panama, Strait of Hormuz, Malacca, Bosphorus, Cape of Good Hope) — critical for trade-finance and goods-backed payment corridors. (2) energy-transition: renewable generation share, fossil fuel demand curve, and grid carbon intensity for US, EU, and global — relevant for climate-risk-adjusted treasury allocation and SFDR PAI reporting. GET, no input required. $0.25 USDC (bundled rate). Data: FRED, EIA. 4h cache.
